<break time="0.8s" /> Either in words or in actions. <break time="0.8s" /> That made Fortunato doubt. <break time="0.8s" /> My good will toward him. <break time="0.8s" /> I kept smiling in his face. <break time="0.8s" /> And he did not notice. <break time="0.8s" /> That my smile now came. <break time="0.8s" /> From the thought of his ruin. <break time="0.8s" /> Fortunato a man respected and even feared. <break time="0.8s" /> In many ways. <break time="0.8s" /> Had one weak point. <break time="0.8s" /> His pride. <break time="0.8s" /> In his knowledge of wine. <break time="0.8s" /> One And a pointed cap with bells. <break time="0.8s" /> I was so pleased. <break time="0.8s" /> To see him. <break time="0.8s" /> That I thought. <break time="0.8s" /> I would never stop. <break
